ja_kanji: 見つけた・わかった［過去・過去分詞］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past and past participle of 'find'!

target_dialogues.question: What did you find in the park?
target_dialogues.answer: I found a cute lost puppy.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

ja_kanji: 撮った・持っていった・乗った［過去］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past tense of 'take' (past participle is 'taken')!

target_dialogues.question: Did you take pictures on your trip?
target_dialogues.answer: Yes, I took many pictures.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past tense of 'forget'!

target_dialogues.question: Where is your umbrella?
target_dialogues.answer: Oh no, I forgot my umbrella on the train!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

ja_kanji: 伝えた・話した［過去・過去分詞］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past and past participle of 'tell'!

target_dialogues.question: What did the teacher tell you?
target_dialogues.answer: She told us an interesting story.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

ja_kanji: 言った［過去・過去分詞］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past and past participle of 'say' (pronounced /sed/)!

target_dialogues.question: What did he say?
target_dialogues.answer: He said 'Thank you!' with a big smile.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

ja_kanji: 聞いた・聞こえた［過去・過去分詞］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular past-tense verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular past and past participle of 'hear'!

target_dialogues.question: Did you hear the news?
target_dialogues.answer: Yes, I heard the good news this morning.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a community or place where people live!
three_hints.feature_hint: A small community in the countryside, smaller than a town or city!

target_dialogues.question: Where did your grandfather live?
target_dialogues.answer: He lived in a quiet mountain village.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a cultural describing word!
three_hints.feature_hint: Passed down for many generations in a country's culture!

target_dialogues.question: What did you see in Kyoto?
target_dialogues.answer: We saw traditional Japanese houses.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 1: Past Stories & Irregular Past (L1-L4)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a communication word!
three_hints.feature_hint: Information or words you leave for someone when they cannot answer the phone!

target_dialogues.question: Can I take a message?
target_dialogues.answer: Please leave a message on my phone.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 2: Future Plans & Phone Calls (L5-L8)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a school or workplace gathering!
three_hints.feature_hint: When people come together to discuss plans and ideas!

target_dialogues.question: Why is the teacher busy?
target_dialogues.answer: She is having a meeting right now.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 2: Future Plans & Phone Calls (L5-L8)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a useful phone conversation phrase!
three_hints.feature_hint: What you say on the phone to ask the caller to wait for a short moment!

target_dialogues.question: May I speak to Ken?
target_dialogues.answer: Sure, please hold on a moment.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 2: Future Plans & Phone Calls (L5-L8)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an exact time of day!
three_hints.feature_hint: Exactly 12:00 in the middle of the day (lunchtime)!

target_dialogues.question: When will the event start?
target_dialogues.answer: It will start at noon.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 2: Future Plans & Phone Calls (L5-L8)

ja_kanji: ひょっとすると・たぶん

three_hints.category_hint: It is an adverb expressing possibility!
three_hints.feature_hint: Another word for 'maybe' when you are not 100% sure!

target_dialogues.question: Will it rain tomorrow?
target_dialogues.answer: Perhaps it will rain in the afternoon.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 2: Future Plans & Phone Calls (L5-L8)

ja_kanji: チャリティー・慈善活動

three_hints.category_hint: It is a social contribution word!
three_hints.feature_hint: Helping people in need by donating money, food, or volunteer work!

target_dialogues.question: Why are they selling cookies?
target_dialogues.answer: They are raising money for charity.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a global issue & SDGs keyword!
three_hints.feature_hint: The serious problem of not having enough food to eat (SDG Goal 2: Zero Hunger)!

target_dialogues.question: Why is this SDG goal important?
target_dialogues.answer: We must work together to end world hunger.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a measurement & travel word!
three_hints.feature_hint: How far it is from one place to another!

target_dialogues.question: Is the station far from here?
target_dialogues.answer: It is a short walking distance.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

ja_kanji: 〜すべきである・〜したほうがよい

three_hints.category_hint: It is an advice modal verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: A modal verb used to give helpful advice or say what is right to do!

target_dialogues.question: What should we do for the earth?
target_dialogues.answer: We should bring our own bags.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an action phrase about waste & environment!
three_hints.feature_hint: To put unwanted trash or garbage into the bin!

target_dialogues.question: What should we not do with plastic?
target_dialogues.answer: We should not throw away plastic in the sea.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a key adjective for expressing opinions!
three_hints.feature_hint: Having great value or meaning—something you must not forget!

target_dialogues.question: What is important to you?
target_dialogues.answer: Family and friends are very important to me.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 3: Rules, Modals & Charity (L9-L12)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a conditional conjunction!
three_hints.feature_hint: A short word that introduces a condition ('If it rains, I will stay home')!

target_dialogues.question: What will you do tomorrow?
target_dialogues.answer: If it is sunny, I will go cycling.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 4: Conjunctions when, if, that (L13-L16)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an essential opinion & debate noun!
three_hints.feature_hint: The 'why' behind your opinion or choice!

target_dialogues.question: Why do you think so?
target_dialogues.answer: I have two reasons for my opinion.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 4: Conjunctions when, if, that (L13-L16)

en_katakana: エクスプラネイション

three_hints.category_hint: It is an academic & debate noun!
three_hints.feature_hint: Details that make an idea or rule easy to understand (from the verb 'explain')!

target_dialogues.question: Did you understand the rule?
target_dialogues.answer: Yes, her explanation was very clear.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 4: Conjunctions when, if, that (L13-L16)

three_hints.category_hint: It is special clothing for festivals or plays!
three_hints.feature_hint: Special clothes worn for a festival, Halloween, or a stage play!

target_dialogues.question: What will you wear to the festival?
target_dialogues.answer: I will wear a traditional costume.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 4: Conjunctions when, if, that (L13-L16)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a historical time word!
three_hints.feature_hint: A period of 100 years (we live in the 21st century)!

target_dialogues.question: When was this castle built?
target_dialogues.answer: It was built in the 17th century.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 4: Conjunctions when, if, that (L13-L16)

three_hints.category_hint: It is something you enjoy in your free time!
three_hints.feature_hint: An activity you love doing in your free time!

target_dialogues.question: What is your hobby?
target_dialogues.answer: My hobby is taking pictures of trains.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

three_hints.category_hint: It is one of the 5 sense verbs!
three_hints.feature_hint: The sense verb you experience with your tongue when eating food ('It tastes good!')!

target_dialogues.question: How is the curry?
target_dialogues.answer: It tastes very delicious!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

three_hints.category_hint: It is one of the 5 sense verbs!
three_hints.feature_hint: The sense verb you experience with your nose ('These flowers smell nice!')!

target_dialogues.question: What is cooking in the kitchen?
target_dialogues.answer: Something smells really sweet!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

ja_kanji: （〜のように）聞こえる・思える

three_hints.category_hint: It is one of the 5 sense verbs!
three_hints.feature_hint: The sense verb you experience with your ears ('That sounds fun!')!

target_dialogues.question: Let's go to the beach!
target_dialogues.answer: That sounds great!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

ja_kanji: 感じる・（〜の）手ざわりがする

three_hints.category_hint: It is one of the 5 sense verbs!
three_hints.feature_hint: To experience an emotion or touch with your hands ('This towel feels soft')!

target_dialogues.question: How do you feel today?
target_dialogues.answer: I feel very happy and relaxed.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a job at a shop or hotel!
three_hints.feature_hint: A person who works at a store counter helping customers!

target_dialogues.question: Who helped you at the store?
target_dialogues.answer: A kind shop clerk helped me find my size.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

ja_kanji: 持ってくる・連れてくる

three_hints.category_hint: It is an everyday action verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: To carry something or someone with you to a place (past tense: 'brought')!

target_dialogues.question: What should I bring to the picnic?
target_dialogues.answer: Please bring your own water bottle.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a club & teamwork verb!
three_hints.feature_hint: To become a member of a club, team, or activity!

target_dialogues.question: Do you want to join our club?
target_dialogues.answer: Yes, I want to join the brass band!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 5: Infinitives, Gerunds & Sense Verbs (L17-L24)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a comparative (-er) adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The comparative form of 'fast' used with 'than'!

target_dialogues.question: Which is faster, a train or a plane?
target_dialogues.answer: A plane is faster than a train.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a superlative (the -est) adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The superlative form of 'fast'—#1 in speed!

target_dialogues.question: What is the fastest land animal?
target_dialogues.answer: A cheetah is the fastest animal.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

ja_kanji: 最も忙しい・最も混雑した［最上級］

three_hints.category_hint: It is a superlative (-iest) adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The superlative form of 'busy'—crowded with the most people!

target_dialogues.question: What is the busiest station in the world?
target_dialogues.answer: Shinjuku is the busiest station in the world.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular comparative adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular comparative form of 'good' and 'well'!

target_dialogues.question: Which do you like better, dogs or cats?
target_dialogues.answer: I think dogs are better companions.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

ja_kanji: 最も良い・最高の［good/wellの最上級］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular superlative adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular superlative form of 'good'—#1 of all!

target_dialogues.question: What season do you think is the best?
target_dialogues.answer: I think spring is the best season.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular comparative adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular comparative form of 'bad' (superlative: 'worst')!

target_dialogues.question: How is the weather getting?
target_dialogues.answer: The storm is getting worse than yesterday.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

ja_kanji: 最も悪い・最悪の［badの最上級］

three_hints.category_hint: It is an irregular superlative adjective!
three_hints.feature_hint: The irregular superlative form of 'bad' (opposite of 'best')!

target_dialogues.question: What was your worst score?
target_dialogues.answer: That was the worst day of the trip!
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 6: Comparatives & Superlatives (L25-L32)

en_katakana: エレクトロニック ディクショナリー

three_hints.category_hint: It is a study tool & JHS G2 debate topic!
three_hints.feature_hint: A compact digital device used to look up English and Japanese words quickly!

target_dialogues.question: Which are better, paper or electronic dictionaries?
target_dialogues.answer: An electronic dictionary is light and easy to carry.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)

JHS_G2.unit: Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)

en_katakana: プラスチック バッグ

three_hints.category_hint: It is a shopping item & JHS G2 debate topic!
three_hints.feature_hint: A thin bag given at convenience stores that we try to reduce for the earth!

target_dialogues.question: Which do you use, paper or plastic bags?
target_dialogues.answer: We should reduce plastic bags for the environment.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)

JHS_G2.unit: Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)

three_hints.category_hint: It is a key debate & sports preposition!
three_hints.feature_hint: Taking the opposite side in a debate or playing versus another team!

target_dialogues.question: Are you for or against the plan?
target_dialogues.answer: I am against the plan for two reasons.
target_dialogues.context: JHS_G2 Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)

JHS_G2.unit: Unit 7: There is/are, Intro Passive & Counter-Arguments (L33-L41)
